image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a printed restaurant menu page. The menu features a large central photograph of a dish (appearing to be a soup or stew with bread/tofu and vegetables) inside a circular frame. Above the image is the restaurant name 'Banh Mi' with decorative red icons. Below the image are text descriptions and prices in a small, sans-serif font. The background is white paper, and the menu appears to be inside a plastic sleeve or binder.

The vertical line of the binder/sleeve on the left wavers slightly and doesn't maintain a perfectly straight geometric perspective, though this is minor.
